Name: Functional Bookcases
Author: novust
Description:
[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/4nSpk6hp/description.png[/img] [/b]

Do you hoard books you've already read instead of selling them? 

Now you have somewhere to store them that isn't just a chest! 

This mod adds bookshelves that match the vanilla ones and can be used as storage for all those extra books, or anything else you want tucked away inside your home! 


[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/FqNzB6cX/requirements-installation.png[/img] [/b]

• The latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51208]Flexible Storage Framework[/url].
• Download and unzip into your mods folder the regular way.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y7FWbmvc/in-game-requirements.png[/img]

None! 

The crafting recipes are available at Robin's Shop from the beginning. 
The bookcases themselves can also be purchased for half the price of their own crafting recipe.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Hpk9sGcQ/compatibility.png[/img]

• Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30321]Carry Chests[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Inventory[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32562]Stack More Things[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30323]Unlimited Storage[/url] (these mods are also all compatible with each other!)
• No known incompatibilities. Please [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53617?tab=posts]let me know[/url] if you find one.
• Not tested in multiplayer or on Android. Please [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53617?tab=posts]let me know[/url] what works (or doesn't!) 


[img]https://i.ibb.co/gFvr0wMd/what-s-next.png[/img]

More bookshelves! Did I miss any? Do you have a modded bookshelf you'd like me to add? I'm open to suggestions!


[img]https://i.ibb.co/tMnmNWTs/my-mods.png[/img]

• Please check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/novust/mods]my mod page[/url] for anything I've made since this one!
